A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the membrane localization of Nef is important for all of its functions.
Nef associates with rafts, but that this is not sufficient for its function.
raft targeting of Nef is required for all Nef functions and that the soluble and raft fractions of the Nef protein have distinct and important functional roles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the raft association of Nef is a critical determinant for the function of Nef in the virus life cycle.
